capabilities.text: Run in Azure, specifically in the UK South region
capabilities.quote: The tool will run in Azure, specifically in the UK South region to meet data residency requirements for NHS patient data.

capabilities.text: Use Azure App Services for the web frontend
capabilities.quote: I’ll use Azure App Services for the web frontend and Azure SQL Database with Transparent Data Encryption for the backend, both compliant with NHS Digital’s security standards.

capabilities.text: Use Azure SQL Database with Transparent Data Encryption for the backend
capabilities.quote: I’ll use Azure App Services for the web frontend and Azure SQL Database with Transparent Data Encryption for the backend, both compliant with NHS Digital’s security standards.

capabilities.text: Enforce authentication via Azure AD, requiring nurses to sign in with NHS credentials
capabilities.quote: Authentication will be enforced via Azure AD, requiring nurses to sign in with their existing NHS credentials.
All data will be retained for 7 years in accordance with NHS data retention policies.
